name: Pick
text: I think we should start by scouring GitHub for open-source AI projects, because it's a treasure trove of innovative ideas and collaborations. This approach allows us to tap into the collective knowledge of the developer community, which can give us a head start in gathering diverse AI information. By focusing on GitHub first, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially missing out on some cutting-edge research that might be shared on other platforms, but I believe the benefits of GitHub's vast repository and active community outweigh this risk. This decision will give us a solid foundation to build upon and inform our subsequent searches on other platforms.

name: Assay
text: While GitHub undoubtedly contains a wealth of open-source AI projects, relying solely on it may limit our exploration of diverse perspectives. Many valuable insights and developments occur outside of traditional coding repositories, especially in forums and discussions on platforms like Reddit or Product Hunt. To settle the argument, I propose we create a balanced strategy that includes GitHub but prioritizes diverse sources, ensuring we capture a wider array of ideas and trends.
